Audience: first-time North Carolina applicants preparing for both the traffic signs test and the regular Class C knowledge test, in English; sign shapes and colors [A01] and pavement line meanings [A05] are recognition items.
Level: picture recognition by shape and color plus rules tied to each sign and marking; a dedicated sign-image drill is declared in part C.
Prerequisites: the traffic signals section, since stop lines apply to signals as well as signs, and the passing section for no-passing zones.
Sensitivity: none beyond stating each sign and marking meaning exactly as printed.
